description: This file defines data models for the Kivy RecycleView component, including classes for managing and dispatching data changes within a MVC pattern, with specific focus on RecycleDataModel and RecycleDataModelBehavior.

classes.name: RecycleDataModelBehavior
classes.description: Base class for models that describe and provide data for RecycleView, emitting 'on_data_changed' events when data is modified.

classes.name: RecycleDataModel
classes.description: Implementation of RecycleDataModelBehavior that stores data in a list and dispatches detailed change events.

methods.name: recondition_slice_assign
methods.description: Adjusts slice assignments based on new and last data lengths, handling negative indices and step values.

methods.name: attach_recycleview
methods.description: Associates a RecycleView with the data model and binds event handlers.

methods.name: detach_recycleview
methods.description: Removes the association with the RecycleView and unbinds event handlers.

methods.name: on_data_changed
methods.description: Event handler called when data changes; meant to be overridden or bound to.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Allows list-like access to data items by index.

methods.name: observable_dict
methods.description: Returns a partial ObservableDict that triggers data change events when modified.

methods.name: _on_data_callback
methods.description: Internal callback that detects the type of data change and dispatches 'on_data_changed' with appropriate arguments.
